description: Pocket type versus genome-encoded diamine supply across 12 genomes, one KEGG request per organism
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, json, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"

T=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/pf03435_typed.csv")
print("pocket type of the iteration-1 anchors:")
for a in ["Q88IS1","Q9HW39","Q9KRL3","O26037","Q55131"]:
    r=T[T.acc==a]
    print(" ",a, (r[["108","109","110","206","251","loop_type"]].values[0].tolist() if len(r) else "not in 242-seq set"))

KO={"K13745":"ddc","K00836":"dat","K01584":"speA","K01585":"speA_alt","K01581":"speC_ODC",
    "K01480":"speB","K13747":"nspC","K13746":"CASDH_KO","K01611":"speD","K00797":"speE"}
ORGS=[("ppu","P. putida KT2440","Type II"),("pae","P. aeruginosa PAO1","Type II"),
      ("pden","Paracoccus denitrificans","Type II"),("bhe","Bartonella henselae","Type II"),
      ("bfr","Bacteroides fragilis","Type I"),("bth","B. thetaiotaomicron","Type I"),
      ("cje","Campylobacter jejuni","Type I"),("hpy","Helicobacter pylori","Type I"),
      ("syn","Synechocystis sp. 6803","Type I"),
      ("vch","Vibrio cholerae","Type III"),("sco","Streptomyces coelicolor","Type III"),
      ("ppr","Photobacterium profundum","Type III")]
rows=[]; fails=[]
for org,name,pt in ORGS:
    try:
        r=requests.get(f"https://rest.kegg.jp/link/ko/{org}", timeout=25)
        kos=set(l.split("\t")[1].replace("ko:","") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n") if "\t" in l) if r.status_code==200 and r.text.strip() else None
    except Exception as e:
        kos=None; fails.append((org,str(e)[:50]))
    if kos is None: fails.append((org,"no data")); continue
    rows.append(dict(org=org, organism=name, pocket_type=pt, n_ko=len(kos),
                     **{k:(1 if k in kos else 0) for k in KO}))
K=pd.DataFrame(rows); K.to_csv(f"{OUT}/kegg_diamine_supply_by_pocket_type.csv", index=False)
print("\nfailures:", fails if fails else "none")
print(K[["organism","pocket_type","n_ko","K13745","K01584","K01585","K01581","K13747","K13746","K01611","K00797"]].to_string(index=False))

K["ADC"]=((K.K01584==1)|(K.K01585==1)).astype(int)
print("\nfraction carrying each gene, by pocket type:")
print(K.groupby("pocket_type")[["K13745","ADC","K01581","K13747","K01611","K00797"]].mean().round(2).to_string())
a=K[(K.pocket_type=="Type III")].K13745.sum(); na=(K.pocket_type=="Type III").sum()
b=K[(K.pocket_type!="Type III")].K13745.sum(); nb=(K.pocket_type!="Type III").sum()
orr,p=fisher_exact([[a,na-a],[b,nb-b]])
print(f"\nddc present: Type III {a}/{na}, Types I+II {b}/{nb}; Fisher p={p:.4g}")

genes=["K13745","K00836","K01584","K01585","K01581","K01480","K13747","K13746","K01611","K00797"]
lab=["ddc\n(->DAP)","dat","speA\nADC","speA alt","speC\nODC","speB","nspC","dehydrog.\nKO","speD","speE"]
K2=K.sort_values(["pocket_type","organism"]).reset_index(drop=True)
cols={"Type I":"#2E7D5B","Type II":"#B03030","Type III":"#3A6EA5"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.8,6.4))
ax.imshow(K2[genes].values.astype(float), cmap="Greys", vmin=0, vmax=1.7, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(genes))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(K2)))
ax.set_yticklabels([r.organism for r in K2.itertuples()], fontsize=10)
for t in ax.get_yticklabels():
    t.set_color(cols[K2.loc[[x.organism for x in K2.itertuples()].index(t.get_text()),"pocket_type"]])
for i in range(len(K2)):
    for j,g in enumerate(genes):
        if K2.loc[i,g]==1: ax.text(j,i,"+",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=13,weight="bold")
for bnd in np.where(K2.pocket_type.values[1:]!=K2.pocket_type.values[:-1])[0]:
    ax.axhline(bnd+0.5, color="k", lw=1.8)
ax.axvline(5.5, color="k", lw=1.2, ls=":")
ax.set_title("Diamine supply genes in KEGG, grouped by pocket type of the resident PF03435 member\n"
             f"ddc, the only route to 1,3-diaminopropane, tracks Type III: {a}/{na} Type III genomes vs {b}/{nb} Type I+II, Fisher p = {p:.3g}",
             fontsize=11.5, loc="left")
ax.text(1.01,0.5,"Type I  characterised CASDH / CAPA-DH\nType II  PP_2928, none characterised\nType III  CANSDH",
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9.5, va="center")
plt.show()
